title: Intentional public Sesh navigation entrypoint
purpose: Make the already-live public Sesh discovery surface intentionally reachable from the shared public site shell.

primaryNavigation.label: Sesh
primaryNavigation.implementation: shared primaryLinks model used by desktop and mobile navigation

sitemap.reason: The Astro sitemap integration already emits https://theriverkeptflowing.com/sesh/.

runtimeBoundary: Navigation links target only the human /sesh/ page.
No Sesh JSON API is introduced or linked.
No SESH_DB access is introduced into navigation components.
No RIVER_IDENTITY_DB access is introduced into navigation components.
No SESH_AUDIO or R2 access is introduced.
privacyBoundary: No project owner identity is exposed.
No private-project existence behavior is introduced.
rightsBoundary: Navigation does not grant copyright, master, composition, publishing, distribution, label, management, royalty, licensing, revenue, collaborator, legal, CRM, account, or identity rights.
